column1: # Japanese patient language -> ICPC-3 S component. OUR writing, Apache-2.0.
# NOT a translation of ICPC-3 (CC BY-ND; a translated term list would be a
# derivative work). Every left-hand side is what a person writes in a symptom
# log; the right-hand side is our judgement about the code, the same codes
# symptoms_zh.tsv and symptoms_en.tsv already use. See res/icpc3/icpc3.NOTICE.
# Same two sentinels as symptoms_zh.tsv: !too-broad and !ambiguous. Matching is
# exact over translate.fold.name_key: one row per spelling a person types,
# kana and kanji both. Bare 熱 is left out on purpose: after the zh-Hant fold
# it would also answer a Chinese 熱 that means only hot.
